capabilities: Write chord progressions in chords code blocks with sections, repeats and time signatures
Play and loop progressions with a toolbar offering tempo, tap tempo and metronome
Transpose charts in semitones and switch between sharp and flat spelling
Identify chords played on a built-in piano and insert them as bars
Rearrange chords by drag and drop, writing changes back to the note
extras: Sampled sounds (Soft Piano, Acoustic Guitar) are not bundled; they download once (about 1.8–6.8 MB) on first use and then work offline. Drag and drop needs a mouse and is unavailable on phones. Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no way to write chord progressions bar by bar and hear them played back inside a note.
summary: Chord chart plugin that turns ```chords code blocks into interactive, playable chord progressions with a piano chord finder.
